Confirm only if you see the DashCast dashboard, instruments, alerts and application. A command receipt does not prove this display.
Confirm that the vehicle is stationary and the firmware context has been checked. This checkbox is an assertion, not a movement measurement. Validation in the car remains necessary.

Close projection and request the factory profile. A failed close remains unresolved even if the factory profile returns. Then confirm the visible instruments and alerts.

Close the temporary BYD projection and verify the factory selection. No custom RCC was selected. Then confirm the instruments and alerts have returned.

Preparation may temporarily open the original BYD projection, then check its display before selecting our RCC. No application starts before Open. Confirm parking and firmware; this assertion does not measure movement.
The connected daemon must use protocol %1$d. Reconnect it in DashCast before trying Prepare or Open again. No BYD command was sent.
2b · Prepare full-screen application

Manual parked test. The app uses 1920 × 720. BYD instruments, speed, gear, telltales, speed limit and alerts are hidden; the existing ADAS masking runs after launch. Close restores ADAS; then restore the factory profile and verify its return. No automatic launch.

Prepare the full-screen app demonstration. Opening hides BYD instruments, telltales and alerts, plus the ADAS panel. Confirm the vehicle is stationary and the firmware is checked. Full restoration is required before installing an older APK.
Apply factory selection

The factory profile is already configured but its native application needs verification. Run one BYD projection transition, close it and read the selection again. No custom RCC or repeated factory selection is sent. Confirm parking and firmware.

Confirm only if the app occupies the entire cluster and the expected BYD elements are hidden. Instruments and alerts are intentionally absent in this demonstration. A receipt does not prove the display.
